name: More magic items and gear
blurb: Magic items, weapons and gear from the books after the Dungeon Master’s Guide: Arcana Unleashed, World of Warcraft, Forge of the Artificer, Faerûn and more.
contents: 171 magic items: Arcana Unleashed (60), World of Warcraft (28), Icecrown Citadel (16), Arcana Unleashed: Deadfall (14), D&D Beyond Drops (11), Forge of the Artificer (9), Netheril’s Fall (8), Adventures in Faerûn (8), Stranger Things: Welcome to the Hellfire Club (8), Heroes of Faerûn and Adventures in Faerûn (3), Heroes of Faerûn (2), The Horrors Within (2), Lorwyn: First Light (2)
16 pieces of gear: clothing, camouflage, poisons and more
Each item has a short summary, its price and its crafting cost and time
about: From your item data of 20 November 2026. Many of these books’ rules aren’t public yet, so several items have only a short description: their notes say so. The three new weapons’ statistics come from early reviews; check D&D Beyond.
